# Little Red Riding Hood

**Source:** Little Red Riding Hood.pdf | **Type:** pdf | **Pages:** 2 | **Ingested:** 2026-05-28

## Summary

The story of Little Red Riding Hood follows a young girl who is sent by her mother to visit her sick grandmother, carrying custards and butter. On her way, she encounters a wolf who tricks her and ultimately devours both her and her grandmother. The tale serves as a cautionary narrative about the dangers of naivety and the importance of being wary of strangers.
